name: Blitz Super Wheel

features.name: Super Wheel
features.description: Randomly awards one of seven features on any spin.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 5–8 spins from the wheel or three scatters.

review:
Blitz Super Wheel can award one of seven random prizes on any spin: 5–10 random wilds, 5–8 Supercharged Wilds that also double all wins, Super Wild Reels with fully stacked wilds, 8–12 mystery symbols, In-Sync Reels, or a Pot Prize from five fixed jackpots worth up to 10,000x.

The wheel can also award 5–8 free spins, which can be triggered by three scatters too. That makes almost every spin a possible feature trigger. The in-game screens advertise up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96.52%. A busy, feature-heavy game for players who like variety.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
